Responsible for maintaining and repairing the hospital. Performs wall patching, plastering, painting, floor repairs, drain cleaning, minor plumbing, and general building maintenance tasks. Repairs beds, furniture, doors, and other facility fixtures as needed. Replaces light bulbs and ballasts to ensure proper facility lighting.

Completes work orders within assigned deadlines and ensures follow-up with stakeholders. Maintains accurate daily logs for assigned tasks, ensuring proper record-keeping. Communicates work order updates to customers to meet expectations.

Responds effectively to fire alarms, evacuation needs, and emergency situations. Follows protocols for internal and external disaster situations (triage code). Ensures compliance with safety regulations and equipment training requirements.

Reports daily to the engineering leadership on facility conditions and progress of work. Assumes House Engineer responsibilities when assigned, ensuring smooth handovers between shifts. Ensures assigned areas remain safe and well-maintained according to regulatory standards.
Reads and interprets blueprints, diagrams, and equipment manuals.
Participates in team meetings and improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and reduce costs.
